purpose: Matching assembled fallback renders for the authored interactive WebGL room. These are illustrative design scenes, not catalog product imagery.

rendering.method: Native authored Three.js WebGL renderer captured through canvas.toDataURL("image/png"), then ImageMagick WebP encoding. No image generation, SVG scene imitation, catalog photography, or UI screenshot pixels.

produce.strategy: Native source rendering and deterministic format conversion
produce.prompt_used: Deterministic static fallback raster, illustrative-not-catalog. Source: src/wood-preview/room-scene.ts, src/wood-preview/room-presets.ts, src/wood-preview/RoomScene.tsx. Native authored Three.js solid room models rendered by production build at http://127.0.0.1:5175/wood-preview/ using Playwright Chromium headless SwiftShader, viewport 1440x1100, deviceScaleFactor 2, prefers-reduced-motion reduce. Select exact room button סלון and finish button עץ בהיר; wait .wood-room-canvas[data-renderer=webgl][data-room=living][data-finish=0][data-assembly=assembled], then two animation frames. Read alpha canvas via preserveDrawingBuffer canvas.toDataURL(image/png), source 1280x940 from a 640x470 CSS canvas; encode with ImageMagick WebP quality92 without resizing. Preserve authored geometry, camera, lights, materials, alpha and shadows; include no UI or page chrome. No image generation and no fictional catalog product.

semantic.implementation: RoomComposer owns semantic HTML room buttons and finish buttons with aria-pressed state, finish label, replay button, and illustrative disclaimer. RoomScene composes one of the nine matching fallback img assets beneath the authored WebGL canvas. CSS owns the 640/470 component aspect ratio and positioning; WebGL owns scene perspective, object shadows, lighting and materials. The corresponding img remains visible if WebGL initialization fails; React state selects the matching room and finish asset.
semantic.notes: Keep these scenes distinct from genuine product gallery photographs. Respect reduced motion by selecting the assembled state; responsive CSS should preserve the room canvas aspect ratio.

assumptions: Fallback should match the fully assembled reduced-motion WebGL state.
All furniture is illustrative and does not represent specific products in the catalog.
UI controls, page background, text and component chrome remain semantic HTML/CSS.

validation.trueAlpha: All files have sRGBA channels, fully transparent alpha minima, and nonopaque image data.
validation.visualInspection: All nine assembled scenes inspected; living-walnut, bedroom-walnut and office-walnut inspected at full 1280x940 scale. Camera padding now preserves the rear wall apex and all geometry. No UI, text, borders, or page background are baked into the images.
validation.deterministicCapture: All nine WebP SHA256 hashes match across two independent Chromium capture runs.
